name: Shenzhen Inovance Technology Co., Ltd. (汇川技术)
fiscal_year_note: Calendar fiscal year (China Accounting Standards). Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) report dated Oct 27, 2026; Q3 is reported only as a quarter plus 9M cumulative figures. FY2026 annual report expected late April 2027. A Hong Kong listing (H-share) application was reported around April 2026 (SCMP via stockanalysis); its status was not verified.
full_year_guidance: No numerical FY2026 company guidance found in the filings reviewed. 9M 2026 actuals: revenue CNY 37.96bn (+19.9%), attributable NI CNY 4.40bn (+3.4%), NI excluding non-recurring items CNY 3.91bn (+0.5%), basic EPS CNY 1.63. Board proposed a 2026 interim dividend of CNY 2.6 per 10 shares (CNY 704m) on Oct 27, 2026. Stockanalysis forward P/E of 22.76x at CNY 55.25 implies consensus forward EPS of about CNY 2.43 (derived).
fx_sensitivity: Low direct exposure: overseas revenue was CNY 1.64bn, 6.6% of H1 2026 revenue (+24.2% YoY). FX losses turned 9M 2026 financial expenses to +CNY 28.7m from -CNY 73.3m a year earlier, and overseas fund fair-value losses cut investment income. The bigger FX effect is competitive: the yen at about JPY 23.5 per CNY (vs JPY 20.5-22.5 assumed by Japanese peers) makes Japanese servo, PLC and robot suppliers cheaper in China.

physical_ai_exposure.description: Upper bound: the 'emerging industries' line (intelligent robots plus digital energy storage) was CNY 1.47bn, 5.9% of H1 2026 revenue, up 96%; industrial-robot revenue alone is not disclosed. Broader motion-control exposure: servo systems about CNY 4.8bn (about 19.5% of revenue), the core component of robots and automated machines. Robot market position (H1 2026): 9.2% of China industrial robots (#3; #2 among domestic brands) and about 25% of SCARA (#1). Humanoid plans: mass-production version of a 7-DoF bionic arm launched and sampled to humanoid makers and research institutes; frameless motors in small-batch use at leading humanoid OEMs; a 'pan-humanoid' industrial solution prototype in customer trials; some component design wins.
physical_ai_exposure.optionality_notes: China humanoid shipments were about 20k units in H1 2026 (+314%, MIR), and Inovance sells joint motors, drives and arms into that chain, but the stock has not been rewarded: it is down about 29% over the past year (stockanalysis), slid from about CNY 72 (Jul 3) to a 52-week low of CNY 48.50 in October 2026, and peaked near CNY 91 in October 2025. JPMorgan (Oct 26) rates it Neutral and sees humanoid supply-chain value shifting toward components amid a cautious Tesla Optimus ramp; Macquarie cut it to Underperform (target CNY 48.90) on Oct 27.

cost_and_supply_chain_notes: Raw material cost pressure was flagged on the Q2 2026 call (stockanalysis summary). Inventory rose 54% YTD to CNY 12.46bn on production for growth and strategic stockpiling; 9M 2026 impairment provisions were CNY 650.5m, mostly inventory write-downs (CNY 518.1m), cutting NI by CNY 441.1m. Receivables rose to CNY 13.33bn (+15.8% YTD) and 9M operating cash flow fell 77% to CNY 0.90bn. Derived Q3 gross margin about 25.5% vs 29.7% in H1 and about 27.5% in Q3 2025. Production is mainly in China; NEV plants in Hungary and Thailand are in volume delivery. US tariff exposure is minimal because overseas sales are only 6.6% of revenue. Capex (cash) 9M 2026 CNY 2.40bn. Likely key inputs (general knowledge): rare-earth magnets, copper, power semiconductors and chips.
competition_notes: Domestic substitution is the core story. China share by revenue in H1 2026: general servo about 35.2% (#1; about 31% in 2025), low-voltage inverters about 20.6% (#1), small PLC about 14.6% (#2), mid/large PLC about 6.7% (#3); 2025 also MV/HV inverters about 14% (#1). Robots: 9.2% of industrial robots (#3; 8.8% and #4 in 2025) and SCARA about 25% (#1). Domestic brands held about 54% of China's 2025 industrial robot market of about 334k units (MIR). Rivals in servos/PLCs are mainly Japanese and European (Yaskawa, Siemens and others). Pricing pressure is most visible in NEV powertrain: gross margin 12.8% in H1 2026, down 4.0 points YoY, while industrial automation held 41.4%.
key_drivers: Industrial automation & digitalization revenue +29.2% YoY in H1 2026 (general automation about +36%)
Share gains: general servo share up about 4 points in a year to 35.2%
China industrial robot output +29.1% YoY Jan-Sep 2026 (NBS); semiconductor-equipment demand in China accelerating (Futu headline, Oct 22)
Emerging businesses (robots + energy storage) +96% YoY; overseas revenue +24%
Humanoid component design wins (joint motors, bionic arm)
Insider support: largest shareholder plans to buy CNY 150-200m of shares; 8th equity incentive plan granted Oct 14, 2026; buybacks with share cancellation
Net cash about CNY 5.8bn (cash and trading assets 9.0bn less debt 3.2bn)
key_risks: Core earnings flat despite +19% revenue: Q3 recurring NI -5.4% YoY; Q3 headline NI boosted by about CNY 437m net non-recurring gains (mostly equity-investment fair-value gains)
China automation demand slowed further in September after a Q2 peak (Futu monthly tracker headline, Oct 21)
NEV powertrain margin compression in China's auto price war (38% of revenue at 12.8% gross margin)
Working-capital strain: inventory +54% YTD, 9M operating cash flow -77%, inventory impairments CNY 518m
Analyst downgrades (Macquarie Underperform, target CNY 48.90; JPMorgan Neutral) and humanoid hype fading

recent_events.event: H1 2025 report: revenue about CNY 20.5bn (Q1 +38.3%, Q2 +19.0% YoY), NI about CNY 2.97bn.
Hong Kong IPO (H-share) application reported by the South China Morning Post (date approximate: about six months before Oct 26).
FY2025 annual report: revenue CNY 45.1bn (+21.8%), attributable NI CNY 5.05bn (+17.8%), final DPS CNY 0.50; Q1 2026: revenue CNY 10.1bn (+13.0%), NI CNY 1.01bn (-23.4%).
Three-day slide (Jul 6-8) during a global robotics and AI-hardware sell-off.
recent_events.stock_reaction: -12.4% over Jul 6-8 (about 72.2 to 63.2), incl. -5.3% on Jul 6

recent_events.event: H1 2026 report: revenue CNY 24.7bn (+20.3%), attributable NI CNY 2.81bn (-5.4%), gross margin 29.7% (-0.5 pt); industrial automation +29%, NEV +4% with NEV gross margin down 4 pts to 12.8%; servo share 35.2%.
Largest shareholder Shenzhen Huichuan Investment (17.2% stake) announces a plan to buy CNY 150-200m of shares; 8th equity incentive plan first grant follows on Oct 14.
Shares near the 52-week low (low of CNY 48.50 set in October 2026; close 49.70 on Oct 16).
recent_events.stock_reaction: About -31% vs the Jul 3 close of about 72.2

recent_events.event: JPMorgan notes a cautious Tesla Optimus ramp (pre-sales guidance 10-20k units, external shipments targeted for end-2027); a follow-up note on Oct 26 rates Inovance Neutral.
Announces 9M 2026 asset impairment provisions of CNY 650.5m (inventory 518.1m, receivables 108.3m), cutting attributable NI by CNY 441.1m.
recent_events.stock_reaction: Not separable (disclosed around the Oct 26 session)

recent_events.event: Q3 2026 report: revenue CNY 13.28bn (+19.1%), attributable NI CNY 1.59bn (+23.6%) but recurring NI CNY 1.15bn (-5.4%); 9M operating cash flow -77%, inventory +54% YTD; interim dividend CNY 0.26/share proposed. Macquarie downgrades to Underperform (target CNY 48.90).

notes: Price is the Oct 26, 2026 close (stockanalysis); intraday Oct 27 after Q3 results was 54.31 (Futu, delayed). Shares = total 2,711.07m (3.57m sit in the buyback account). USD conversion at CNY 6.686/USD (Fed H.10, Oct 16, 2026). cash_and_investments = cash 6.12 + trading financial assets 2.89 (Sep 30, 2026); total_debt = short-term borrowings 0.55 + long-term borrowings 1.08 + current portion of non-current liabilities 1.34 + lease liabilities 0.20. Inovance does not disclose orders. Q3 operating margin is not disclosed; 9M operating profit (营业利润, includes fair-value gains) was CNY 4.66bn, a 12.3% margin. Q3 gross margin (25.5%) and Q3 2025 gross margin (27.5%) are derived from cumulative figures. FY2025 operating income (5.26) and FCF (3.66) are stockanalysis definitions; FY2025 R&D not found (9M 2026 R&D CNY 3.43bn, +14.4%). pe_forward is stockanalysis (22.76x); trailing P/E about 28.8x on TTM NI of CNY 5.19bn (derived); pb = market cap / owners' equity 38.47bn (Futu shows 3.83x at 54.31). ev_ebitda_forward not found; stockanalysis TTM EV/EBITDA was 19.6x at CNY 49.70 (Oct 16), about 21-22x at 55.25 (our scaling). dividend_yield_pct uses the CNY 0.50 FY2025 final dividend; including the proposed CNY 0.26 interim gives about 1.4%. Segment shares computed from H1 2026 revenue; sub-lines (general automation about 44.6%, servo 19.5%, inverters 13.4%, PLC/HMI 5.7%, elevator 9.7%) are approximate figures from the interim report text. Market shares come from the company's reports citing Frost & Sullivan (2025) and MIR. The CNY 91 October 2025 peak is inferred from Google Finance's 52-week range on Sep 28, 2026 (49.95-91.00) versus stockanalysis's range on Oct 26, 2026 (48.50-84.05). The H-share application date is approximate.
